 IPL 2027: Hardik Pandya can be captain at KKR or RR, feels Ravichandran Ashwin
 Mumbai Indians finished in 9th place in the IPL 2026 season under the captaincy of all-rounder Hardik Pandya earlier this year.
 Written by: Devadyuti Das 
 Published: October 29, 2026, 2:17 PM IST

 IPL 2027: The Player Retention deadline is fast closing in ahead of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2027. With the IPL 2027 mini auction set to take place December 16 in Goa, all 10 IPL teams will have to finalise their retentions by November 15 – the IPL 2027 Retention Day. One Indian cricketer who has bee the biggest topic of discussion in this trading window has been Mumbai Indians captain and all-rounder Hardik Pandya. 
 The Baroda all-rounder’s move back to Mumbai has not been a happy one in the last couple of seasons. In two seasons with Gujarat Titans, Hardik had led them to the title once and reached the final in the subsequent season. But at MI, he only has a 42.4 per cent win-loss record with 14 wins and 19 losses in 33 matches in charge. 
 Read more: 
 CSK will not have batting coach for IPL 2027: Chennai Super Kings part ways with Michael Hussey after 8 years 
 Under Hardik, MI failed to qualify for the Playoffs stages in IPL 2026 earlier this year as they finished in 9th place with just 4 wins in the season. Retained for Rs 16.35 crore by Nita Ambani’s MI, Hardik could be on his way out before the 2027 season. 
 According to IPL trade rumours, Chennai Super Kings are one team who are interested in bringing Hardik Pandya on board through a possible trade. But Ravichandran Ashwin believes that Hardik Pandya can be offered Kolkata Knight Riders or Rajasthan Royals captaincy if he moves to these sides.
 “KKR have great potential because Hardik can also become the captain there. They could offer Varun Chakaravarthy for him. But as long as Abhishek Nayar is there, I don’t think Varun will move from KKR. Harshit Rana and Rinku Singh could be other options. With RR (Rajasthan Royals), it could be Yashasvi Jaiswal and Sam Curran, or Brijesh Sharma or Tushar Deshpande. It could also be Jaiswal with Yash Raj Punja or Bishnoi,” Ashwin said on his YouTube channel.

 On possible cricketers that Mumbai Indians may need in the Hardik Pandya trade, Ashwin felt that the five-time former winners need an Indian wicketkeeper-batter.
 “MI desperately need an Indian keeper. They will also look to strengthen their bowling, which has been dismal the last few years. PBKS with Omarzai could interest MI. No one is talking about GT, but they could get involved by giving Rashid Khan for Hardik,” Ashwin said.
 The former CSK all-rounder also believes that in addition to the above-mentioned teams, there are other teams in the race for Pandya as well.
 “There are as many as six teams in battle for Hardik Pandya, is what I hear. But I don’t think that’s the case, as LSG aren’t in the race. It’s mainly CSK (Chennai Super Kings), KKR, RR, GT (Gujarat Titans) and PBKS (Punjab Kings). I also think captaincy isn’t a must for Hardik anymore in his next franchise. He will just want to go to the ideal franchise for him, as he’s keen to move on from MI,” said Ashwin
 The 33-year-old all-rounder has scored 2955 runs in 162 matches in his IPL career at a strike-rate of 146.28 and also claimed 82 wickets. But in IPL 2026, Hardik only managed to score 206 runs in 10 games at an average of 22.88 and only managed to pick up 4 wickets.
